svg.aria-label: CabalMesh concept hardware — dimensioned orthographic views
svg.text: Concept enclosures, Phase 2 — mechanical intent only. All dimensions in millimetres.
1.9 kg · matte anodised Al, finned flanks
Readout + 8 proof lamps · NET cut-off switch
Fanless · 12 W idle, 25 W while proving
BLE 5.3 · Wi-Fi 6 · LoRa in the RADIO bay
Roto-moulded LLDPE over a steel latch frame
Motorised bolt · no keyhole on the outside
Load cell in the floor · status ring at the latch
— 0.24 px/mm, with a phone for reference. One of these is furniture; one fits on a desk.
EACH PANEL STATES ITS OWN SCALE — THE LOCKER IS DRAWN SMALLER SO IT FITS. THE STRIP ABOVE IS THE HONEST COMPARISON.
